text:
Maria (Finance): Noticing a -$12,045 "free_tier_credit" adjustment on our March AWS Marketplace invoice (INV-2027-03-7890). This doesn't line up with our partner reports. Anyone seen this before? Invoice PDF attached.
billing-bot: New invoice posted: INV-2027-03-7890 · total $98,765 · adjustments: -$12,045 (free_tier_credit). Details: https://console.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/checkout/invoices/INV-2027-03-7890
Arjun (Billing Ops): I pulled the portal CSV and there's a credit line flagged as free_tier_credit. No internal promo recorded. Can you paste the CSV lines here?
Maria (Finance): CSV snippet:
```
invoice_line_id,description,amount,currency
L-00123,Compute usage,110000,USD
L-00124,Marketplace fees,-12045,USD  # free_tier_credit
L-00125,Support,2810,USD
```
Jenna (Accountant): That amount is material and unexpected. Pausing revenue recognition for affected lines until resolved. @Sam can you confirm partner mapping & contract clause on promo absorption?
Sam (Cloud Partnerships): Checking contract: partner liable for promos up to $5k/quarter per clause. This is ~12k so doesn't fit. Reached out to AWS rep + partner AM.
Tomas (Sales Ops): Confirmed contract language. Looks like AWS applied credits to our vendor invoice by mistake. Recommend opening AWS support case.
Arjun (Billing Ops): Case opened: AWS Support case #1234567890. Message: "Unexpected 'free_tier_credit' -$12,045 on INV-2027-03-7890. Possible merchant tag mismatch; request reversal or corrected invoice. Attached reconciliation."
Maria (Finance): Uploaded reconciliation CSV to drive: https://redwood-internal.app/fin/reconciliations/INV-2027-03-7890.csv. Created ticket FIN-3249 to track AR/cash impact.
Jenna (Accountant): I'll hold revenue recognition pending AWS confirmation. If AWS won't reverse, we need written confirmation from partner that they absorbed credit.
Sam (Cloud Partnerships): AWS replied: "investigating merchant tag mismatch; will issue reversal or corrected invoice within 3 business days." Reply saved to support case.
Arjun (Billing Ops): I'll monitor case and post updates here. If corrected invoice arrives, I'll re-run month-end reconciliation and update FIN-3249.
Maria (Finance): Owner assigned: @Arjun. Please escalate to TAM if no movement in 48 hrs. (reaction: :eyes:)
Tomas (Sales Ops): I'll prepare legal template for partner confirmation if needed.
Jenna (Accountant): Arjun, when corrected invoice arrives please export invoice CSV and drop into FIN-3249 for audit trail.
Arjun (Billing Ops): Will do. Marking this thread as tracked. (reaction: :thumbsup:)
